prompt: Create a standard rustic crate from whatever fixed references Fantasy Asset Forge currently supports, then deliver its directional PNGs, review contact sheet, and GLB without changing the reference design. I need an evidence report suitable for another engineer to audit. Work as a fresh MCP client with no repository-source access. If you cannot actually call a tool, write the exact intended call and mark its result unverified rather than pretending it ran.
assertions: The output calls inspect_capabilities and list_kits before create_asset and requires runtime confirmation for asset.reference.crate plus outputs; when tools are unavailable, it shows the intended calls and marks support unassessed.
The output uses create_asset only with the fixed crate reference and does not invent a new asset identity or canonical document.

The output explicitly states that create_asset has no dry-run mode and records its returned initial revision when executed; when unavailable, it leaves the revision unassessed without fabricating dry-run evidence.
The output inspects the created asset before any optional follow-up mutation and performs no unnecessary mutation when the unchanged reference satisfies the brief.
The output requires validate_asset, render_preview, export_asset, artifact identity checks, and audit-only artifact verification.
The output requires interactive 3D, contact-sheet, and every actual 128x128 frame review, including clipping, framing, ground, silhouette, and material separation.
The output does not read source, hand-author canonical JSON, directly write product artifacts, or manufacture successful tool evidence.
The final verdict remains fail or unverified when required runtime or visual evidence is unavailable.
